Definition: from G1223 and the base of G2425; to reach through, i.e. penetrate:--pierce.
BiblicalUsage: The word of God pierces, and this is the verb for that piercing, going right through and dividing soul and spirit. Hebrews uses it once, of a sword that cuts deeper than any blade we know.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Scripture does not skim the surface of my life; it pierces to the joints and marrow, and that is why I let it search me.
